source.title: C2 broad unittest discovery is not a reliable validation gate: `PYTHONPATH=tools:tests python3 -m unittest discover -s t
source.objective: C2 broad unittest discovery is not a reliable validation gate: `PYTHONPATH=tools:tests python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_c2_*.py" -q` aborts because an imported CLI path invokes argparse (`python3 -m unittest clear ... --source-modified-at`), after many ResourceWarnings for unclosed sqlite connections. This forces hand-maintained targeted test lists and increases validation latency/risk. Fix test discovery/import side effects when convenient; do not block the C3 migration on it.
